physical_height_and_mass_contract.explanation: The ledger follows the continuous, integral-normalized triangular cell model. Native ShaderWorld brush output truncates heights to integer centimeters across sequential passes, and the collision mesh samples that result. The checked final surface differs from the 150 cm model target by up to 2.000778210 cm. Exact model grams are not an independent measurement of the quantized mesh volume.
physical_height_and_mass_contract.gate: Work waits for three stable nine-point collision passes within 5 cm. A mismatching region is requested again every 2 seconds. The acceptance phase is bounded to 300 seconds.
physical_height_and_mass_contract.scope_limit: This tolerance was selected for four brushes in this laboratory. It is not a universal error bound or completion guarantee for an arbitrary brush stack, world size, terrain profile or collision resolution.
